messages:
Alex M.: heads-up: FinCap hit our staging quotas during integration tests. They want a temporary demo uplift for org_fincap_9921 — demo is Tue 16:00 UTC and they asked for an 8x burst for ~2h.
Sam K.: do we know whether they're bumping per-key or per-org? enforcement paths differ.
Alex M.: per-org. their harness ran parallel agents. need staging-only scope.
Jordan (eng-platform): we can apply an override scoped to env=staging in the router. needs TTL and audit trail.
Maria S.: security rule: TTL required + approver and justification. redacted customer-audit entry only.
Priya (sales-ops): can support trigger this from console? a single-click "Grant Demo Burst" would be ideal with mandatory ticket id.
Sam K.: ops suggestion: override record (applied via admin API) + circuit-breaker in router for auto-revoke on regressions. record ticket #7012 for trace.
Jordan (eng-platform): API example (internal):

```
POST /internal/admin/overrides
{
  "org_id": "org_fincap_9921",
  "env": "staging",
  "quota": {"multiplier": 8, "burst": 40},
  "expires_at": 1782008799,
  "approved_by": "Priya (sales-ops)",
  "ticket": "#7012",
  "meta": {"purpose": "demo"}
}
```

Router refreshes overrides cache every 15-30s.
Alex M.: can we land this today? need it available for rehearsal.
Sam K.: add automatic fallback: if error_rate > 4% or p95 latency jumps > 300ms for 2m, automatically revoke and page oncall. Also require manager sign-off for multiplier >5x.
Priya (sales-ops): will obtain Raj's sign-off and attach to ticket #7012.
Jordan (eng-platform): UI work: Admin -> Quotas -> Temporary Overrides list. include apply/revoke, TTL countdown, link to ticket, and minimal redaction for customer feed.
Sam K.: runbook for support: steps to create override (console), verify via GET /internal/admin/overrides/:id, monitor metrics, and revoke. include emergency/manual-revoke command.
Support Bot: ticket #7012 created and assigned to @alex_m. awaiting manager approval.
DeployBot: canary deploy started for admin-api (deploy/ci #4590).
Jordan (eng-platform): canary at 10% traffic now; monitoring dashboards green.
Sam K.: router change includes circuit-check; will auto-revoke on thresholds. added logging hooks for audit.
Alex M.: rehearsal checklist: run 75% load, capture tokens/sec, p95, errors. will report back in this thread.
Priya (sales-ops): Raj approved in ticket. :white_check_mark:
Maria S.: confirm we emit two audit events: internal with full payload, and redacted to customer activity (org id + reason + expires_at). tag override as 'temporary-demo' and include ticket id.
Jordan (eng-platform): creating ledger entry in weekly quota-changes sheet for postmortem.
Sam K.: add dashboard widget under Eng -> Quotas -> Temp Overrides showing active overrides with token/sec and error rate overlays.
Alex M.: rehearsal passed. window request: 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z -> 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z. please apply.
Jordan (eng-platform): applied override id ov_7021 scoped to staging; expires_at = 1782008799. console link: https://console.internal/admin/overrides/ov_7021
Support Bot: override ov_7021 active in staging; monitoring hooks live.
Sam K.: circuit-check green in staging, rollback hook armed.
Maria S.: post-demo action: review whether sales self-serve for enterprise demos is acceptable and document risk thresholds + guardrails.
Alex M.: thanks all — will debrief after demo. tagging @Priya and @Jordan for follow-up.
